name: The Bare Escape
source:
The Bare Escape is a super silly game about the heroine, Val (name changeable), waking up trapped in a tower with two guys who seem to be missing their clothes… And all the while being watched by a mysterious sorceress. Good luck working together to pass the Tower’s tests to escape!

Feel free to flirt with everyone along the way, or don’t! If your heart only belongs to adventure, that’s cool too!

[From [url=https://vagrant-muffin.itch.io/the-bare-escape] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Bare Escape》是一款超级愚蠢的游戏，主角瓦尔（名字可更改）醒来，发现自己被困在一座塔里，身边还有两个男人，他们的衣服似乎不见了……并且一直被一个神秘女巫监视着。祝你好运，齐心协力，通过塔楼的考验，成功逃脱！

一路上随意与每个人调情，或者不！如果你的心只属于冒险，那也很酷！

[来自[url=https://vagrant-muffin.itch.io/the-bare-escape] itch.io[/url]]
